name: Darien YMCA School Age Camp
street_address: 204 Hollow Tree Ridge Rd (Middlesex Middle School)
description_short: A traditional co-ed day camp run by the Darien YMCA for children who have just finished kindergarten through 7th grade, with groups arranged by grade. Camp runs 8:30 AM–3:30 PM, and activities include swimming lessons, sailing, canoeing, arts and crafts, STEM, sports and field trips.
swim_waterfront_notes: Includes swimming lessons, sailing and canoeing. Paddle boarding is only for the Adventure (finished grades 4–5) and Pioneers (finished grades 6–7) groups. The page does not say where the water activities take place.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season, and that summer is over (today is 2026-10-13). Dates, fees and location for 2027 have not been posted yet.
The 2026 camp was held at Middlesex Middle School, not at the YMCA (2420 Post Rd, Darien). The location could change for 2027.

Weekly fees depend on the camper's group and on YMCA membership. Members paid $444–$485 a week and non-members $538–$585. Week 9 was $444 for members and $538 for non-members. Because rates vary, I left price_per_week and each session's price blank.
8-week totals with the discount code were $3,374–$3,686 for members and $4,089–$4,446 for non-members.

Registration was staggered. On Jan 20 it opened to members who live in Darien or are returning campers. On Jan 22 it opened to members who don't live in Darien, and on Jan 27 to everyone. The session registration date shown is the earliest of these.
Grades are the grade the child has just finished. Grade 0 means just finished kindergarten.
Extended care costs $120 a week extra. Campers are bused from Middlesex Middle School to the Darien YMCA. You must register ahead of time; drop-ins are not allowed.
The page has an unrelated March 3 school-closure notice.
